target: learned body heading or direct horizontal velocity from future Android-capturable inputs
artifact_download_policy: bounded official metadata only; no new dataset rows or model weights

locked_claims.scope: research and development and/or educational purposes

locked_claims.https_certificate_note: hostname mismatch from the Docker standard-library client; audited over the official HTTP endpoint

candidates.name: RoNIN
candidates.platform_and_collection: Android phones attached to a Tango ground-truth rig; natural placements and seen/unseen subjects

inference_inputs.evidence: Adapter v2 maps only Android raw accelerometer, gyroscope, optional Game Rotation Vector, and original sensor timestamps.

raw_semantics.evidence: Raw game_rv x,y,z,w ordering and device axes were independently corrected and physically sanity-checked.

target_fitness.evidence: Tango-derived continuous velocity and body heading exist as labels only.

rate_50_100_hz.evidence: Raw streams can be deterministically anti-aliased and replayed at both locked rates; the official 200 Hz checkpoint is not reused.

leakage_controls.evidence: Subject/device/placement/sequence identifiers support pre-window group splits.

provenance.evidence: Public archive, sequence hashes, pinned adapter, and public-only retraining path can be fixed; the private-data official checkpoint is excluded.

rights.evidence: The artifact-specific custom license permits non-commercial scientific research and prohibits commercial product/service use.

deployment.evidence: Dataset-derived product weights are outside the grant; GPL reference code and supplied weights remain isolated.

candidates.allowed_next_use: Frozen benchmark-only technical-headroom experiment with non-shippable weights; no product training or distribution.

candidates.name: RIDI
candidates.platform_and_collection: Android Tango phone, ten subjects, four placements, roughly 200 Hz, Tango trajectory truth

inference_inputs.evidence: The Android collector exposes raw accelerometer/gyroscope and optional platform sensors; Tango fields are excluded.

raw_semantics.evidence: The official page links an unversioned Box artifact; archive-specific raw-vs-processed columns and calibration terms were not retrieved under this metadata-only gate.

target_fitness.evidence: Continuous Tango trajectory supports velocity supervision when kept label-only.

rate_50_100_hz.evidence: The 200 Hz sequence stream can be anti-aliased to 100/50 Hz; 200 Hz is not made a product requirement.

leakage_controls.evidence: Subject, placement, and sequence groups are described before windowing.

provenance.evidence: The data download is not record-versioned or content-hashed on the official project page.

rights.evidence: The official data page has a download link but no dataset license; the MIT code license does not license data or derived weights.

deployment.evidence: Artifact and derived-weight product rights are not stated.

candidates.allowed_next_use: Owner/artifact license clarification and a bounded archive manifest only; no rows, training, or weight distribution.

candidates.name: OxIOD
candidates.platform_and_collection: Mixed iPhone and Nexus devices, multiple attachments, Vicon/Tango or derived trajectory truth

inference_inputs.evidence: Accessible synchronized schema does not establish a full Android raw accelerometer plus gyroscope subset; Apple Core Motion fields are not Android inputs.

raw_semantics.evidence: Platform attitude, gravity, and user-acceleration semantics are mixed across Apple and Android and cannot be silently mapped.

target_fitness.evidence: Fine-grained trajectory truth exists for continuous inertial odometry supervision.

rate_50_100_hz.evidence: The documented model/data path includes 100 Hz operation.

leakage_controls.evidence: User, device, attachment, and sequence groups are documented.

provenance.evidence: The official 1.01G download has no visible immutable record version or artifact checksum.

rights.evidence: No dataset license or commercial ML/derived-weight grant appears on the official page.

deployment.evidence: Product rights for data and resulting weights are not stated.

candidates.allowed_next_use: License/schema clarification only; do not download or train a product candidate.

candidates.name: ADVIO
candidates.platform_and_collection: Rigid iPhone, Pixel, and Tango rig; raw phone IMU is iPhone-only while Pixel exports ARCore pose

inference_inputs.evidence: Raw accelerometer/gyroscope/magnetometer files are documented under iPhone; the Pixel directory contains ARCore pose only.

raw_semantics.evidence: Apple CoreMotion g/device-frame signals are explicit but are not a captured Android raw stream from the rig.

target_fitness.evidence: A 100 Hz continuous ground-truth pose is available as a label.

rate_50_100_hz.evidence: The iPhone raw stream and truth are documented at 100 Hz, but this does not cure platform mismatch.

leakage_controls.evidence: Twenty-three rig sequences do not provide the user/device/placement diversity needed for passive phone generalization.

provenance.evidence: Zenodo record 1476931 exposes 23 versioned files and the official code page is revision-pinned.

rights.evidence: ADVIO data is CC BY-NC 4.0 and therefore cannot support commercial product training.

deployment.evidence: Non-commercial data-derived weights cannot be treated as shippable product assets.

candidates.allowed_next_use: Non-commercial visual-inertial benchmark only; no Android product-model claim.

candidates.name: IDOL
candidates.platform_and_collection: iPhone 8 rigidly attached to a LiDAR-VIO Stencil rig; 15 users, three buildings, 100 Hz

inference_inputs.evidence: The only smartphone raw stream is from iPhone 8, not an Android SensorEvent stream.

raw_semantics.evidence: iPhone axes and CoreMotion orientation are documented but cannot be assumed semantically identical to Android raw/fused sensors.

target_fitness.evidence: Continuous Stencil position and orientation are available as labels.

rate_50_100_hz.evidence: All readings are sampled at 100 Hz.

leakage_controls.evidence: Subject IDs and disjoint known/unknown user splits are explicit before windowing.

provenance.evidence: Zenodo v1.0 fixes four file records with checksums and documents synchronization/alignment.

rights.evidence: Zenodo records the dataset under CC BY 4.0, which does not impose a non-commercial restriction.

deployment.evidence: A clean implementation may respect CC BY attribution, but platform/rig incompatibility still blocks this target.

candidates.allowed_next_use: Cross-platform/fixed-rig benchmark only; do not label resulting behavior Android passive-PDR evidence.

candidates.name: FDA Open-Access Wearables gait dataset
candidates.platform_and_collection: Samsung Galaxy S22 and iPhone 10 at lower back/right thigh, five orientations, straight/curved trials, 20 participants, 100 Hz

inference_inputs.evidence: The Samsung Galaxy S22 stream contains uncalibrated 3-axis phone acceleration and gyroscope data obtainable from Android sensors.

raw_semantics.evidence: The FDA explicitly distinguishes uncalibrated phone data from aligned/reference data; only the unaligned raw subset is eligible.

target_fitness.evidence: Reference IMUs and a short pressure walkway support gait/contact metrics, not continuous 2D trajectory or body heading.

rate_50_100_hz.evidence: Phone, reference IMU, and walkway sampling are set to 100 Hz and can be downsampled to 50 Hz.

leakage_controls.evidence: Participant, platform, placement, orientation, and trial factors support grouped splits.

provenance.evidence: The FDA catalog ID, Synapse entity IDs, synchronization method, and final 374-trial count are explicit.

rights.evidence: The access wiki permits research/development and education and prohibits redistribution, but does not explicitly grant commercial ML training or derived-weight product rights.

deployment.evidence: No explicit product/derived-weight distribution boundary is stated.

candidates.allowed_next_use: Terms clarification first; scientifically useful only for step/contact and placement robustness, not the heading/velocity target.

candidates.name: An inertial and positioning dataset for the walking activity
candidates.platform_and_collection: Nineteen participants using heterogeneous personal Android/iOS phones handheld outdoors; GNSS, device step count, and trundle-wheel distance

inference_inputs.evidence: An Android-only subset can map acceleration-with-gravity, rotation rate, GNSS, and platform step count to ordinary Android APIs.

raw_semantics.evidence: Two apps and mixed operating systems require a row-level Android subset and timestamp/axis audit before use.

target_fitness.evidence: Truth is total or one-metre incremental distance; GNSS/device heading is not accurate continuous body-heading or 2D trajectory truth.

rate_50_100_hz.evidence: Personal-phone rates vary by track and missing intervals are explicit; 50/100 Hz availability cannot be assumed.

leakage_controls.evidence: Subject, device/OS, and track metadata exist before windowing.

provenance.evidence: Dryad version 6 is immutable, licensed, and reports 166454135 storage bytes plus subject/track structure.

rights.evidence: Dryad records the artifact under CC0-1.0.

deployment.evidence: CC0 does not impose a non-commercial or redistribution restriction; privacy and attribution provenance remain documented.

candidates.allowed_next_use: Android-subset preflight for distance, gap, and heterogeneous-device robustness only; never use GNSS/device heading as body-heading truth.

candidates.name: RuDaCoP
candidates.platform_and_collection: About 1200 Android smartphone sequences from more than 100 people, multiple devices and natural placements, with two foot-mounted reference IMUs

inference_inputs.evidence: The paper describes exact Android OS smartphone sensor readings with accelerometer, gyroscope, and magnetic streams; foot IMUs remain labels only.

raw_semantics.evidence: Units, calibrated/uncalibrated sensor variants, Android-origin readings, and device/placement metadata are documented.

target_fitness.evidence: Post-processed foot-IMU trajectories provide continuous labels without entering inference.

rate_50_100_hz.evidence: Recorded streams can be causally resampled to the locked 50/100 Hz profiles without requiring a 200 Hz product path.

leakage_controls.evidence: Person, device, placement, and sequence diversity support group-level splits.

provenance.evidence: The official page offers email/temporary links but no immutable artifact record, version, or checksum.

rights.evidence: The official page says freely downloadable but states no dataset license, commercial ML grant, redistribution terms, or derived-weight rights.

deployment.evidence: Product training and resulting weight distribution require written owner/legal clarification.

candidates.allowed_next_use: Highest-priority owner/license clarification candidate; do not request/download rows or train until rights and an immutable artifact manifest are obtained.

next_research_boundary: No personal pilot and no product model training. A separately preregistered benchmark-only headroom experiment may use non-shippable weights, while RuDaCoP/RIDI/OxIOD/FDA require artifact-specific rights clarification.
